summary: Tested the PRC Refund Audit feature end to end (backend + admin UI + user UI). 11 of 12 backend pytest cases pass. Classification is correct for all 7 seeded cases: missing; retry_failed missing 500; recharge missing; flagged not listed; not_deducted; bill_payment mirror skipped; ledger-equal counted as refunded. Report-only scan does not change balances. Apply refunds each item exactly once, and re-running apply changes nothing. Ledger and prc_ledger credit rows are written with txn_type refund. 5 concurrent refund-one calls give one 200 and four 400. manual-refund and recharge admin refund both refuse a second refund. Cron: 401 without auth or with a wrong token, 200 accepted with the secret, duplicate:true on the same X-Webhook-Id. List refund_state/source_collection, detail refund_info (recharge_transactions is used, completed shows not_applicable) and receipt prc_refund_amount/refund_at all work. Admin UI works: panel stats, Scan, row Refund, Refund All with confirm, all-clear text, list badges and Refund buttons, refund-status-box, and the modal Refund button only shows for the missing state. User UI works: 'PRC Refunded · 250' and 'Refund in progress' badges, and receipt-refund-amount. I found and fixed a critical 500 on the unfiltered admin BBPS list. I also found a security gap: refund and list endpoints under /api/redeem/admin and /api/recharge/admin need no auth.

critical.issue: FIXED by testing agent. Returned 500 (TypeError: '<' not supported between datetime and str) because unique.sort(key=created_at) mixed datetime-typed created_at (11 redeem_requests docs in preview) with ISO strings. The admin BBPS dashboard list failed on its default load. The sort key now normalizes datetime to isoformat.

No authentication. The admin middleware in server.py only guards paths starting with /api/admin/. An anonymous curl refunded PRC (200 success) and read the full BBPS list including user PII. The idempotency guard limits the money risk, but these are admin-only actions. Likely pre-existing.

minor.issue: Sets total_prc_deducted=0 after a refund. The user receipt then shows 'PRC Deducted: -' next to 'PRC Refunded: 250', and the original deduction amount is lost from the doc.

The 'already running' check uses find_one and then insert, which is not atomic. Two simultaneous run requests can start two runs. Refunds stay safe because of the refund_events guard, but the work runs twice. A unique partial index or findOneAndUpdate lock would fix it.
Uses created_at < ISO string. Docs with a datetime-typed created_at are never checked as stuck.

A doc with prc_refunded=True, no ledger debit, and a crash between the claim and the credit is classified as 'refunded' even though no credit was ever written. refund_events with status 'claimed' and never 'done' could be used to find these.

ui_bugs.issue: Rows with status refund_pending (27 in preview) show 'Not Refunded · X' and a red Refund button. Clicking it always fails with toast 'Only failed transactions can be refunded (status: refund_pending)', because refund-one only accepts FAILED_STATUSES and the audit counts these separately. Either hide the button and show an 'Eko refund pending' state for refund_pending, or allow refunds for that status.

issues: After 'Refund All', the 'Not refunded' stat still shows '1 · 400 PRC' (the count at scan time) next to the 'All failed transactions... are refunded' message, which is confusing. Show missing minus refunded_now, or rename the label to 'Found not refunded'.
The service column shows raw values like 'mobile'; the list uses friendlier labels.
The all-clear message shows even when Needs review > 0.

action_items: Add admin auth (Bearer admin token) to /api/redeem/admin/* and /api/recharge/admin/* refund and list endpoints, or extend the middleware prefix check.
Handle refund_pending rows in the BBPS list: no 'Not Refunded' badge or Refund button that always fails, or make refund-one accept refund_pending.
Keep the original total_prc_deducted after a recharge refund so the receipt still shows the deducted amount.
Optional: clearer 'Not refunded' stat after an apply run.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed by me: the unified_redeem_v2.get_bbps_requests sort crashed on mixed datetime/str created_at.
Admin routes outside the /api/admin prefix are unauthenticated (security).

The refund_events key includes debit_count, so a later retry debit allows a new refund. This is intended, but it relies on ledger debit_count being accurate; legacy docs without a ledger always use key :0.
The RefundAuditPanel load() errors are swallowed (catch(() => {})), so the panel shows nothing if the API fails. Consider an error state.

success_rate.backend: 92% (11/12; the failing case is the unauthenticated admin-refund security probe)
success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested testids and flows work; refund_pending list button is inconsistent)
